verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms FireHydrant serves an llms.txt file at its documentation domain (HTTP 200, titled 'FireHydrant Documentation'), so a user can point an agent at it directly. Several doc pages are also served as raw .md URLs, which suggests agent-friendly markdown docs. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/agent-oriented docs offering, evidence of llms.txt content depth (e.g., an llms-full.txt or complete page index), independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
